import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')

def job_worst(seed, universe_bits=16, ntrain=10000, npred=32, width=4, density='never'):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    nf = 8; slots = 2
    sizes = [2]*nf  # 2^16 = 65536 universe
    fields = []
    for i in range(nf):
        t = ['time','size','count','id','flag'][i % 5]
        fields.append({'name':'f%d'%i,'type':t,'domain':[0, 1000000 if density!='never' else 500]})
    numeric = [f for f in fields if f['type'] in ('time','size','count')]
    preds=[]
    for k in range(npred):
        f = numeric[k % len(numeric)]
        if density == 'never':
            # always false over the whole universe -> no covers, no pruning
            preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[k % slots, f['name']]},'op':'ge','right':{'const':999999,'type':f['type']}})
        else:
            preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[k % slots, f['name']]},'op':'ge','right':{'const':0,'type':f['type']}})
    train=[[[rng.choice(f['domain']) for f in fields] for _ in range(slots)] for _ in range(ntrain)]
    queries=[{'fixed':[],'target':[rng.randrange(slots), rng.choice(fields)['name']],'prefix':''} for _ in range(64)]
    return {'fields':fields,'slots':slots,'predicates':preds,'width':width,'train':train,
            'approved':[],'queries':queries}

t0=time.time()
jobs=[job_worst(s, density='never') for s in range(2)]
jobs+= [job_worst(100, density='always') for _ in range(1)]
batch={'jobs':jobs}
raw=json.dumps(batch)
print('gen %.2fs bytes %d' % (time.time()-t0, len(raw)))
open('/workspace/tmp/worst_batch.json','w').write(raw)
